decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out several items in the feed that were accessories (cases, cables, and chargers) rather than actual speakers. My consideration set focused on highly-rated portable speakers with waterproof ratings and good customer feedback. The INSMY speaker (prod_bluetooth_speakers_128) stood out as the best value proposition, featuring 20W power, an IPX7 waterproof rating, and a 4.6-star rating with over 6,500 reviews, while maintaining a competitive $29.99 price point. While the JBL Charge 4 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_013) is a strong competitor from a premium brand, the INSMY being a new unit with similar specs at a third of the price made it the most logical choice for this shopping session.
